title: FORCED_BROWSING / authorization enforcement: server may not enforce its own advertised availableActions.cancelOrder=false flag
unsupported_reason: The hypothesis is that once GET /api/order reports availableActions.cancelOrder=false, the server must itself enforce that flag and refuse a direct POST /api/order/cancel call reaching it via forced browsing (i.e. bypassing the client-side disabled/hidden button) — an authorization/enforcement claim about whether the client-only flag is also checked server-side, not a numeric sum comparison. sum_lte cannot express 'the server must reject a call that its own response marked as unavailable.' The financial consequence of this same gap, if the call is accepted, is covered separately by the amount_bound double-cancel scenario (01_double_cancel_amount_bound.plan.json).
